summary: Returns the value as a relative path, or throws.
description: The exact complement of `isAbsolute`: anything that does not start at a root, which includes the empty string.
`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).

params.message: The message of the exception. A default is used when omitted.
params.strict: When `true`, a string counts as empty only if it has no characters at all; by default whitespace is trimmed first.

returns: the same value, typed as a relative path.

throws.IllegalArgumentException: the value is not a relative path.

examples.title: What passes and what does not
examples.body:
```javascript
requireRelative("docs/readme.md"); // => "docs/readme.md"
requireRelative("./a"); // => "./a"
requireRelative("/var/log"); // throws IllegalArgumentException
requireRelative("https://example.com/a"); // throws IllegalArgumentException
```
